issue.title: test_create_review_button_enters_review_and_back_restores_configure sees create-project availability still 'checking' under the full xdist lane

task_type_fields.evidence:
Proposed by phase sase-1pj.6.1.2 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note #2, 2026-10-31) and filed by the sase-1pj.6.1 land agent.

- Failure: during that phase's `sase tool run check`, which escalated to the full 4-worker xdist suite, this test observed the create-project availability state still at `checking` 0.6 seconds after it opened the review step. It expected the resolved state.
- Pass: a focused rerun of the same node on the same tree passed.
- Fail rate: 1 failure in 1 full parallel run; 0 failures in 1 focused serial rerun. It was not reproduced serially.
- Unrelated to the phase: sase-1pj.6.1.2 changed only staged pipe/successor recovery code, which is not in the new-project modal's import closure.
- Likely area: a fixed 0.6 s wait on an async availability probe, which a loaded xdist worker can outrun. Confirm this before changing the test, and never weaken the assertion.
task_type_fields.repro_cmd: sase tool run check (full 4-worker xdist escalation)

issue.creation_reason: Phase sase-1pj.6.1.2 saw this node fail once in the full 4-worker suite and pass on a focused rerun, and no bead owns it.
